en.name: CCTV installation & surveillance
en.headline: A clear view. A considered system.
en.intro: Plan coverage around entrances, movement and the areas that matter. Camera count alone does not define a useful surveillance system.

sections.title: Coverage before camera count
sections.body: Coverage, lighting, mounting height and privacy boundaries guide the choice of camera and lens. Discuss night conditions and the detail you need to recognize.

sections.title: Recording & remote access
sections.body: Match DVR/NVR compatibility, PoE needs and storage to the recording schedule. Retention depends on bitrate, resolution, activity and drive capacity.

sw.name: Ufungaji wa CCTV
sw.headline: Ulinzi unaoanza kwa kuona vizuri.
sw.intro: Panga kamera kulingana na milango, mienendo ya watu na maeneo muhimu. Idadi ya kamera pekee haitoshi kuamua ufanisi wa mfumo.

sections.title: Mpangilio wa kamera kwanza
sections.body: Maeneo ya kufuatilia, mwanga, urefu wa kufunga kamera na faragha vinaongoza uchaguzi. Eleza hali ya usiku na maelezo unayotaka kuyaona.

sections.title: Uhifadhi na ufuatiliaji wa mbali
sections.body: Linganisha DVR/NVR, PoE na uwezo wa diski na muda wa kurekodi. Muda wa kuhifadhi hutegemea ubora wa video, matukio na ukubwa wa diski.

requirements: Mpangilio wa eneo na sehemu za kamera
Hali ya mchana/usiku na muda wa kuhifadhi video

en.name: Electric fencing
en.headline: A stronger perimeter. Planned responsibly.
en.intro: Assess the wall, fence line, earthing conditions and public access before selecting equipment. Perimeter work needs a site-specific plan.

sections.title: Fence line & energizer
sections.body: Confirm the perimeter length, zones, vegetation and mounting conditions. Energizer selection must suit the installation and applicable safety requirements.

sections.title: Earthing, warning & testing
sections.body: Discuss earth electrodes, surge protection, warning signs, alarm output and maintenance access. Agree testing and handover scope in the quotation.

sw.name: Uzio wa umeme
sw.headline: Ulinzi wa mipaka uliopangwa kwa makini.
sw.intro: Tathmini ukuta, njia ya uzio, hali ya ardhi na sehemu zinazofikiwa na watu kabla ya kuchagua vifaa. Kila eneo linahitaji mpango wake.

sections.title: Uzio na energizer
sections.body: Thibitisha urefu wa eneo, kanda, mimea na sehemu za kufunga vifaa. Energizer ichaguliwe kulingana na kazi na masharti ya usalama.

sections.title: Earth, tahadhari na majaribio
sections.body: Jadili earth electrodes, kinga ya msukumo wa umeme, alama za tahadhari na kengele. Kubalianeni majaribio na makabidhiano kwenye nukuu ya bei.

requirements: Vipimo vya eneo na hali ya ukuta
Njia za watu na mimea iliyo karibu
Kengele zilizopo na mahitaji ya umeme wa akiba

en.name: Gate automation
en.headline: A smooth arrival. A secure entrance.
en.intro: Choose automation around the gate itself: movement, weight, travel and daily use. A motor cannot correct an unsuitable mechanical installation.

sections.title: Sliding or swing
sections.body: Assess rails, hinges, stops and the opening width. Confirm operating cycles, power availability and manual release arrangements.

sections.title: Safety & access
sections.body: Discuss safety beams, obstruction detection, pedestrian access, remotes and intercom integration. Final compatibility is confirmed against the selected motor.

requirements: Gate type, approximate weight and width
Daily use and access control needs

sw.name: Milango ya kiotomatiki
sw.headline: Kuingia kwa urahisi. Usalama mlangoni.
sw.intro: Chagua mfumo kulingana na lango: mwendo, uzito, umbali na matumizi ya kila siku. Motor haiwezi kurekebisha hitilafu za msingi za lango.

sections.title: Lango la kuteleza au bawaba
sections.body: Tathmini reli, bawaba, vizuizi na upana wa kufunguka. Thibitisha marudio ya matumizi, umeme na namna ya kufungua bila motor.

sections.title: Usalama na udhibiti wa kuingia
sections.body: Jadili safety beams, kugundua kizuizi, njia ya watembea kwa miguu na remote. Uoanifu wa intercom uthibitishwe kwa motor iliyochaguliwa.

requirements: Aina, uzito wa makadirio na upana wa lango
Matumizi ya kila siku na udhibiti wa kuingia
sw.scopeHeadline: Mwendo, usalama na matumizi ya kila siku.

en.name: Electrical contracting
en.headline: The infrastructure behind every system.
en.intro: From electrical materials to installation and maintenance enquiries, define the circuits, loads and interfaces before deciding the equipment.

sections.title: Distribution & protection
sections.body: Discuss distribution boards, circuit allocation, protective devices, earthing and surge protection. Ratings and cable sizes require assessment, not a general online recommendation.

sections.title: A coordinated installation
sections.body: Lighting, sockets, equipment feeds and standby supply should be considered together. Existing installation condition and required testing shape the work scope.

requirements: New installation, alteration or maintenance scope
en.scopeHeadline: From the board to the final circuit.

sw.name: Kazi za umeme
sw.headline: Miundombinu inayowezesha kila mfumo.
sw.intro: Kuanzia vifaa hadi ufungaji na matengenezo, bainisha saketi, mizigo ya umeme na uunganishaji kabla ya kuamua vifaa.

sections.title: Usambazaji na kinga
sections.body: Jadili distribution boards, mgawanyo wa saketi, vifaa vya kinga, earth na surge protection. Ukubwa wa nyaya na vifaa uamuliwe baada ya tathmini.

sections.title: Ufungaji ulioratibiwa
sections.body: Taa, soketi, umeme wa vifaa na vyanzo vya akiba vipangwe pamoja. Hali ya mfumo uliopo na majaribio yanayohitajika huamua kazi.

requirements: Taarifa za umeme na mizigo ya vifaa
sw.scopeHeadline: Kuanzia distribution board hadi saketi ya mwisho.

en.name: Solar & battery systems
en.headline: Power shaped around your day.
en.intro: Begin with consumption and the hours you need power. Solar output, inverter capacity and usable battery energy answer different questions.

sections.title: Load & energy planning
sections.body: List running and starting loads, daytime consumption and overnight needs. Roof space, shading and cable routes affect the system design.

sections.title: Hybrid operation & batteries
sections.body: Discuss inverter/battery compatibility, usable capacity, protection and changeover behavior. Ask for a defined operating scenario rather than an unsupported autonomy promise.

requirements: Required backup hours and priority circuits

sw.name: Sola na mifumo ya betri
sw.headline: Nishati inayolingana na matumizi yako.
sw.intro: Anza na matumizi na saa unazohitaji umeme. Uzalishaji wa sola, uwezo wa inverter na nishati ya betri ni vipimo tofauti.

sections.title: Kupanga mahitaji ya nishati
sections.body: Orodhesha mizigo ya kawaida na wakati wa kuwasha, matumizi ya mchana na usiku. Paa, vivuli na njia za nyaya huathiri muundo.

sections.title: Hybrid inverter na betri
sections.body: Jadili uoanifu, uwezo unaotumika, vifaa vya kinga na kubadilisha vyanzo. Omba maelezo ya matumizi yaliyokubaliwa badala ya ahadi ya saa bila tathmini.

requirements: Bili za umeme na orodha ya vifaa
Saa za akiba na saketi za kipaumbele

en.name: UPS & backup power
en.headline: Continuity for the equipment that matters.
en.intro: Protect critical equipment by distinguishing short interruptions from long outages. UPS, battery and generator systems have different roles.

sections.title: Critical loads first
sections.body: Identify CCTV, networking, communications and office equipment that must stay on. Confirm both watts and VA, starting behavior and required runtime.

sections.title: Changeover & maintenance
sections.body: Plan transfer behavior, battery replacement access, alarms and testing. Final autonomy is confirmed for the selected load and battery configuration.

en.scopeHeadline: The right load. The right runtime.

sw.name: UPS na umeme wa akiba
sw.headline: Mwendelezo kwa vifaa muhimu.
sw.intro: Linda vifaa muhimu kwa kutofautisha kukatika kwa muda mfupi na muda mrefu. UPS, betri na jenereta zina majukumu tofauti.

sections.title: Vifaa muhimu kwanza
sections.body: Bainisha CCTV, mitandao, simu na vifaa vya ofisi vinavyopaswa kuendelea. Thibitisha watts, VA na muda unaohitajika.

sections.title: Kubadilisha chanzo na matengenezo
sections.body: Panga mabadiliko ya chanzo, ufikiaji wa betri, tahadhari na majaribio. Muda wa akiba uthibitishwe kwa mzigo na betri zilizochaguliwa.

en.name: Generator systems & integration
en.headline: Standby power. Considered as a whole.
en.intro: Generator enquiries need more than a kVA figure. Match the load, location, changeover, distribution and service requirements as one system.

sections.title: Sizing & installation interfaces
sections.body: Share starting currents, phase requirements and load sequence. Ventilation, exhaust, access, noise and fuel arrangements require a site assessment.

sections.title: ATS, service & parts
sections.body: Discuss manual/automatic transfer, protection and integration with solar or UPS. For service parts, provide generator, engine and alternator identifiers; compatibility is verified before quotation.

requirements: Load schedule, phase and starting loads
Site layout, access and operating hours
Model/serial identifiers for service or parts

sw.name: Jenereta na uunganishaji wa umeme
sw.headline: Umeme wa akiba. Mfumo mzima uzingatiwe.
sw.intro: Mahitaji ya jenereta ni zaidi ya kVA. Oanisha mzigo, eneo, changeover, usambazaji na matengenezo kama mfumo mmoja.

sections.title: Ukubwa na mahitaji ya ufungaji
sections.body: Eleza umeme wa kuwasha vifaa, single/three phase na mpangilio wa kuwasha. Hewa, moshi, kelele, mafuta na ufikiaji vinahitaji tathmini.

sections.title: ATS, matengenezo na vipuri
sections.body: Jadili kubadilisha chanzo, kinga na uunganishaji na sola au UPS. Kwa vipuri, leta modeli na serial number za jenereta, engine na alternator; uoanifu uhakikiwe kwanza.

requirements: Orodha ya mizigo, phase na umeme wa kuwasha
Mpangilio wa eneo na saa za matumizi
Modeli/serial number kwa matengenezo au vipuri

en.name: ICT & structured networking
en.headline: Connections you can build on.
en.intro: A maintainable network starts with organized cabling, clear device roles and realistic coverage requirements.

sections.title: Cabling & cabinets
sections.body: Plan data points, patch panels, racks, cabinet ventilation and cable labeling. Confirm cable category and testing requirements against the project specification.

sections.title: Wi-Fi, switching & separation
sections.body: Consider access-point placement, PoE budget, uplinks and separation of guest, office and security traffic. Internet service subscriptions are confirmed separately.

requirements: Floor plans and number of data points
Expected users, PoE devices and Wi-Fi areas

sw.name: TEHAMA na mitandao
sw.headline: Mawasiliano yenye miundombinu imara.
sw.intro: Mtandao unaotunzwa kwa urahisi huanza na nyaya zilizopangwa, majukumu ya vifaa na mahitaji halisi ya coverage.

sections.title: Nyaya na makabati
sections.body: Panga data points, patch panels, racks, hewa na alama za nyaya. Aina ya cable na majaribio vithibitishwe kulingana na mahitaji.

sections.title: Wi-Fi na usimamizi wa mtandao
sections.body: Zingatia sehemu za access points, PoE, uplinks na kutenganisha wageni, ofisi na mifumo ya usalama. Huduma ya intaneti ikubaliwe kando.

requirements: Michoro na idadi ya data points
Watumiaji, vifaa vya PoE na maeneo ya Wi-Fi
Intaneti/router na mifumo ya usalama iliyopo

en.name: Office & hotel telephone systems
en.headline: Every extension. Part of the conversation.
en.intro: Plan internal calling, reception and external lines around how your organization communicates. IP-PBX depends on the network as well as the phones.

sections.title: Extensions & call flow
sections.body: Discuss departments, guest rooms, reception, ring groups and transfer rules. Hotel reception and room requirements should be specified before choosing equipment.

sections.title: IP-PBX & compatibility
sections.body: Confirm SIP accounts, analog gateways, PoE, backup power and handset compatibility. PMS integration or specialist features require separate compatibility confirmation.

requirements: Existing PBX, handsets and external lines
Reception, call routing and network needs

sw.name: Simu za ofisi na hoteli
sw.headline: Kila extension ina nafasi yake.
sw.intro: Panga simu za ndani, mapokezi na laini za nje kulingana na mawasiliano ya taasisi. IP-PBX hutegemea mtandao pamoja na simu.

sections.title: Extensions na mpangilio wa simu
sections.body: Jadili idara, vyumba, mapokezi, ring groups na kuhamisha simu. Mahitaji ya hoteli yabainishwe kabla ya kuchagua vifaa.

sections.title: IP-PBX na uoanifu
sections.body: Thibitisha SIP accounts, analog gateways, PoE, umeme wa akiba na simu. Uunganishaji wa PMS au vipengele maalumu uhakikiwe kando.

requirements: PBX, simu na laini za nje zilizopo
Mahitaji ya mapokezi, kupitisha simu na mtandao

en.name: Institutional procurement
en.headline: From specification to a clear proposal.
en.intro: Bring a BOQ, equipment schedule or technical brief. A useful proposal makes the supplied scope, substitutions and delivery assumptions visible.

sections.title: Specification-led sourcing
sections.body: Confirm quantities, ratings, approved makes, documentation and required delivery location. Proposed alternatives should be identified for your review, never silently substituted.

sections.title: Commercial clarity
sections.body: Request itemized supply/installation scope, lead-time confirmation and warranty terms. Tender eligibility, certifications and manufacturer authorizations are supplied only when verified for the specific requirement.

sw.name: Ugavi wa vifaa kwa taasisi
sw.headline: Kutoka mahitaji hadi nukuu iliyo wazi.
sw.intro: Leta BOQ, orodha ya vifaa au maelezo ya kiufundi. Nukuu nzuri inaonyesha vifaa, mbadala na masharti ya uwasilishaji kwa uwazi.

sections.title: Ugavi kwa kuzingatia vipimo
sections.body: Thibitisha idadi, ratings, chapa zinazokubalika, nyaraka na eneo la kufikisha. Mbadala uonyeshwe kwa mapitio yako, usibadilishwe kimya kimya.

sections.title: Uwazi wa masharti
sections.body: Omba mgawanyo wa vifaa/ufungaji, muda wa upatikanaji na dhamana. Sifa za zabuni, vyeti na uwakilishi wa mtengenezaji vitolewe tu vikithibitishwa kwa kazi husika.
